description: Land Title Settlement Department - Batugammana, Monaragala D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720035 (23/0288)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to multiple land parcels with specific cadastral references, and includes a detailed schedule listing land parcels, their extents, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registration, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
